property.name: dbt_user
property.description: Account that owns the dbt configuration directory. Analysts run dbt as themselves; this only owns what Ambari writes.

property.name: dbt_conf_dir
property.description: Where the connection profile is written. Point DBT_PROFILES_DIR here, which dbt-env.sh does for you.

property.name: dbt_profile_name
property.description: Name of the profile written to profiles.yml. A project that names a different profile still runs: pass --profile, or set this to the name the project expects.

property.name: dbt_target
property.description: Target inside the profile that dbt uses by default.

property.name: dbt_trino_host
property.description: Host of the Trino coordinator the transformations run in. Trino is deployed outside the stack, so this is the address that host is reachable at from these nodes.

property.name: dbt_trino_catalog
property.description: Catalog the models are built in. An Iceberg catalog allows tables to be created and replaced; a read-only catalog supports only views and tests.

property.name: dbt_trino_threads
property.description: How many models dbt builds at once. Lower it to be gentler on a shared engine.

property.name: dbt_auth_method
property.description: How dbt authenticates to Trino. On a secured cluster this is Kerberos; the other modes exist for engines that do not use it.

property.name: dbt_trino_user
property.description: Identity the transformations run as. Grant it write access on the catalog and schema above. With Kerberos this is overridden by the principal that ran kinit.

property.name: dbt_trino_password
property.description: Only for username and password authentication.

property.name: dbt_trino_jwt_token
property.description: Only for token authentication. Use a service token with a long lifetime, since nothing refreshes it between runs.

property.name: dbt_trino_service_name
property.description: Service part of the Trino principal, for Kerberos authentication.

property.name: dbt_ssl_verify
property.description: Path to the certificate authority bundle used to verify Trino's certificate. Leave blank to use the system trust store.

property.name: content
property.description: Sourced by users before running dbt, so the profile and the tools are on the path.
